investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Asterstack Bank (digital banking); Platform: Microsoft Azure northeurope (zones northeurope-1/northeurope-2/northeurope-3); network range 10.40.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster asters-prod-northe (AKS); Database: postgres instance kyc-db-01 for kyc-svc; Deployments: Helm releases rolled out by a CI release bot after human approval; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
